attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Ashen Hand have been seen patrolling the edges of the Merrow road again","reason":"Briefing says there is no new news; this patrolling event is invented."},{"span":"Their numbers seem to be growing","reason":"Unsupported claim; the briefing gives only a static count of 4 settlements."},{"span":"making the Merrow Freeholds reconsider their travel routes once more","reason":"Invented reaction not in the briefing."},{"span":"moved their largest settlement north by twenty leagues","reason":"Invented event and distance."},{"span":"the last dry spell","reason":"Not in the briefing."},{"span":"the first sightings of the firebeast in the region","reason":"Invented creature and event."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It invents several events (patrols, a settlement move, a firebeast) even though the briefing says nothing new happened. It also breaks format by copying the briefing's section headings into the bulletin, and it has none of Ilse's dry wit."}
